title: Uppercase destinations, sentence-case stop
description: Destination headsigns are uppercased with slight positive letter-spacing (~0.02em) while the stop name stays sentence-case — case contrast now signals the header/row split independent of weight or size.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue .arrival-row__headsign (currently sentence-case, no letter-spacing); app/pages/index.vue .screen__stop-name (sentence-case, unchanged)

Leave the stop name in sentence case as the contrast anchor.
